supporting_observations.claim: Repeated svc-routes logon failures occurred approximately once per minute from 13:32 to 13:47 UTC. The failures identify FILE-COP-01 as the workstation and originate from 10.52.20.20.
The supplied failure records report incorrect-password status for svc-routes, including domain-controller validation events.

The cadence and source of the failures are consistent with the supplied inventory description of RouteSync re-authenticating every minute on FILE-COP-01, and their timing follows the scheduled svc-routes password rotation at 13:30 UTC. This supports stale job credentials after rotation as the likely explanation.

At 14:18 UTC, WS-PBECKER-01 recorded an explicit-credential event targeting svc-routes on FILE-COP-01, with SYSTEM as the subject and taskhostw.exe as the process. This is compatible with an attempted update from the designated IT administration workstation, but the record alone does not establish the purpose or outcome.

known_telemetry_limitations: The supplied records show authentication failures but do not include RouteSync application or service-configuration logs.
The supplied records do not establish whether the scheduled password rotation completed or whether the RouteSync job was successfully updated.
The 14:18 explicit-credential event does not show whether authentication succeeded or what action followed.
claims_not_established: Whether the password rotation was completed at 13:30 UTC and whether the job retained its old credential.
Whether the 14:18 explicit-credential event was the authorized manual job update or whether it succeeded.
Whether any activity outside the supplied records occurred.
